data.raw_text:
LOOK: Firefighters train their hoses on a residential area engulfed in flames in the Gasangan, Baseco Port Area, Manila on Saturday, May 30. The blaze reached the third alarm.

Residents also assisted in efforts to contain the fire and prevent it from spreading to nearby houses. Authorities have yet to determine the cause of the fire.

📷: Mark Balmores | MB
